$comment: Product analytics event catalog (docs/product-analytics.md). Every track('<name>', props) call in apps/web must use a name listed here and only the props declared for it; `pnpm check:events` enforces that in CI. Prop types: string | number | boolean. `pii: true` means the event may identify a person: it is sent to self-hosted sinks only (Umami), never to third-party sinks (PostHog Cloud, GA4, Yandex Metrika). Rage clicks, dead clicks, web vitals and exceptions are not listed: PostHog autocaptures them ($rageclick, $dead_click, $web_vitals, $exception); Umami covers web vitals and heatmaps itself.

page_view.description: SPA route change. `route` is the route pattern (e.g. /projects/$projectId), never the concrete URL.

site_cta_clicked.description: A call to action on the marketing site (apps/site) was clicked. `cta` is the link's data-cta id (hero_start, nav_sign_in...).

waitlist_joined.description: A visitor joined the waitlist on a landing page drafted by /validate-idea (docs/validate-idea.md). `variant` is the page variant id (e.g. the price under test, `pro_29`), never the email or any free text.

signup_started.description: The sign-up form was opened on the sign-in page.

two_factor_enabled.description: TOTP two-factor authentication was turned on (authenticator code verified) on the security page.

privacy_export_requested.description: A data export was requested on the privacy page (`subject`: user or org).

privacy_deletion_requested.description: Account (`subject` user) or organization (`org`) deletion was scheduled on the privacy page.

privacy_deletion_cancelled.description: A scheduled deletion was cancelled in its grace period on the privacy page.

two_factor_disabled.description: Two-factor authentication was turned off on the security page.

passkey_added.description: A passkey was registered on the security page.

password_reset_requested.description: A password reset link was requested from the sign-in page (mailed only if the account exists).

password_reset_completed.description: A new password was set from the emailed reset link.

invitation_accepted.description: An organization invitation was accepted from the emailed link.

member_invited.description: An org admin invited someone by email from the members page. `role` is member or admin.

org_created.description: An organization was created from the onboarding card or the org switcher.

billing_checkout_started.description: An admin started checkout for a paid plan on the billing page. `plan` is the plan id from config/plans.json.

billing_canceled.description: An admin canceled the paid plan (it ends at the period end).

ai_summary_shown.description: An AI summary was displayed to a member for review.

ai_summary_reviewed.description: A member confirmed or corrected an AI summary.

ai_feedback.description: Thumbs up/down on an AI result. Also sent as a Langfuse score and a PostHog AI-observability survey response when configured.

api_error.description: An API call the user triggered failed. `path` has ids replaced by :id; `trace_id` links to the OpenTelemetry trace and the Sentry/GlitchTip event.

form_error.description: Browser form validation blocked a submit (required, too short...). Field names only, never values.

api_key_created.description: An org admin created an API key. `scopes` is how many scopes it has.

ai_provider_created.description: An org admin added the organization's own AI provider. `kind` is api, aggregator or custom; `purposes` how many uses it serves.

mcp_server_connected.description: An org admin connected an external MCP server. `tools` is how many tools AI features may call on it; `has_auth` whether it has an auth header.

webhook_endpoint_created.description: An org admin added a webhook endpoint. `event_types` is how many events it subscribes to.

consent_set.description: The user answered the analytics consent banner.

booking_opened.description: A booking link (site "Book a demo", app "Talk to us") was clicked; docs/crm.md. `source` is site or app. Opens the Cal.com embed or, without booking consent, the Cal.com page.

booking_completed.description: The Cal.com embed reported a booking (bookingSuccessfulV2). Bookings made on the Cal.com page itself are not seen here; the CRM gets every booking from the webhook (docs/crm.md).

onboarding_tour_started.description: The product tour on the projects page started (docs/onboarding.md). `manual` is true when restarted from the user menu.

onboarding_tour_completed.description: The product tour was closed on its last step.

onboarding_tour_dismissed.description: The product tour was closed before its last step. `step` is the 0-based step it was closed on.

onboarding_checklist_dismissed.description: The onboarding checklist card was dismissed. `done` is how many items were done.

support_opened.description: The Help menu opened the support widget (docs/support.md). `kind` is what the user picked: question, bug or feature_request.
